scoring: organisers' self-evaluation rule: every annotator record scored separately, IoU > 0.5 pairs are TP, pooled PQ; real label maps through src/postproc.score_file
protocol: all probability maps out of fold; refiner of fold k trained without fold k; keep model cross-fitted by fold; its threshold chosen for fold k by an inner cross-fit that never sees fold k (strict nesting). The shape settings (blend 0.5, threshold 0.5, absorb 0.3) were chosen on all five folds: with that choice nested as well, the refiner row is 0.4483 and the final row about 0.455

stages.name: v2 single model, fixed keep rule (area >= 300, mean probability >= 0.85)
two-model average, grouping through probability >= 0.1, written at >= 0.48 (predict.POST_STACK)
learned keep rule + refiner shapes (predict_final, the final pipeline)

keep_rule: src/keep.py after the 11/12 review: member descriptors symmetric in the dense models, stable ranks
